basic_info.description: Situated in a coveted Bernal Heights location, this exquisitely updated four-bedroom, four-bathroom home seamlessly blends modern sophistication with classic charm. Behind its timeless Victorian facade, the airy open floor plan impresses with soaring ceilings, rich wood floors, and ample natural light. A thoughtfully renovated gourmet kitchen boasts stainless-steel appliances, custom cabinetry, and sleek quartz countertops, while an updated bathroom adds convenience to the main level. The living and dining areas flow effortlessly to a BBQ patio, and sun-drenched backyardan ideal retreat for relaxation or entertaining. Upstairs, a skylight overhead floods the top level, while the sought-after three-bedroom, two-bath layout features a serene primary suite with vaulted ceilings, two private terraces, and tranquil garden views. Two additional bedrooms capture breathtaking bay vistas. The lower level offers a large, private guest quarters with an en-suite bath, adjacent to a well-appointed laundry area. The garage offers additional storage, EV charging, and completes this exceptional home. Located just steps to Bernal Heights Park and to Cortland's vibrant boutiques, Michelin-rated restaurants, and easy commuter access to HWY 101/280. This gem checks all the boxes!
